g.text: Foxf1, Fzd4 and Lrp6 are lower in transitional gCap states
Within-animal state contrasts; conditions contain different animals | canonical-response RNA remains descriptive
Dots: individual animals; black marks: means. Genes were predefined; panels shown are an exploratory selection.
Sparse Axin2 detection and state labels do not establish pathway activity, a temporal transition or a functional requirement.
